name: corx
description: corx — a CORS proxy running on Cloudflare (Hono + D1 + R2)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vite build --mode client && vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 database: API keys, request logs, quotas and the blocklist. Cloudflare provisions it during deploy.

CACHE_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for the GET response cache. Cloudflare provisions it during deploy.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required. Bearer token for `/api/*` and the console login — generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Optional. HMAC key for console session cookies; falls back to `ADMIN_TOKEN`.

INJECTION_KEK.description: Optional. Encrypts injected variable values at rest; rotate with `npm run kek:rotate` instead of changing it.

PROXY_ZONE.description: Optional. Subdomain-mode suffix (`example.corx.com` → `example.com`); empty auto-detects the request host.

PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional. Raw value of the public-tier key rendered on the landing page (the hosted-instance demo).

DEMO_KEY.description: Optional. Raw value of the landing page's injection-demo key; only for the hosted demo.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Optional. Cloudflare Access team domain; set together with `ACCESS_AUD`.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Optional. Cloudflare Access application AUD tag; set together with `ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN`.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Optional. Comma-separated email allowlist for admin access.
